name: Ireland
study_positioning: English-speaking EU destination for undergraduate, postgraduate, IT, business, healthcare and post-study work pathways.

visa.route: Long Stay D Study visa where visa-required
additional_costs: Irish Residence Permit registration after arrival is commonly EUR 300
process: Apply online through the Irish visa system
Submit documents through the instructed office/VFS route
Provide biometrics if resident in India
visa.deadlines: Apply well before the course start date. Processing times vary by office and season.
notes: Course should generally be full-time with at least 15 hours per week for eligible study routes.
Evidence of funds and private medical insurance is required.
